title: ProDS: Preference-oriented Data Selection for Instruction Tuning
authors_zh: Wenya Guo、Zhengkun Zhang、Xumeng Liu 等（南开大学、百度）
paper_type_zh: 偏好导向的指令数据选择研究
best_for_zh: 适合需要让监督微调数据贴合特定目标任务偏好的读者。
one_line: ProDS selects instruction records by their alignment with positive and negative target preference directions.
ProDS 用目标任务的正反偏好方向衡量样本影响，从而选择更适合监督微调的指令记录。
why: It treats preference alignment as a criterion for SFT-data selection rather than only a final optimization objective.
inclusion_reason: Uses target-task preference directions to choose which SFT records a model should consume.

title: Problem
问题
html:
Instruction-data selectors commonly score whether an input-response pair is difficult, diverse, or useful for predicting a target answer. Open-ended assistants also need to match how users prefer among plausible answers, so a subset that predicts references well can still teach the wrong response style for the task a model will actually serve.

ProDS asks how target-set preference information can select SFT records. It represents preferences between better and worse target responses with DPO gradients, measures each training record's alignment with both an improving and a degrading direction, and keeps records that favor the former while avoiding the latter.

指令数据选择器通常衡量输入—回答对是否困难、多样或有助于预测目标答案。但开放式助手还必须贴合用户在多个合理回答之间的偏好，因此，一个能很好预测参考答案的子集，仍可能向模型传授不适合实际目标任务的回答风格。

ProDS 追问如何用目标集合的偏好信息选择监督微调记录。它以 DPO 梯度表示更好与更差目标回答之间的偏好，衡量每条训练记录与改善方向和退化方向的对齐程度，并保留支持前者、同时回避后者的记录。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
ProDS turns a target preference into a data-selection signal. A small SFT warm-up produces an instruction-following model; a DPO warm-up on constructed target pairs yields gradient directions for moving toward preferred and away from dispreferred answers. A training record is valued by how its influence correlates with both directions.

The selected object remains an ordinary instruction-response triplet, augmented during curation by pairwise preference gradients and a score. GPT-4 is used to judge whether a generated target response differs from the reference when forming warm-up pairs. This is distinct from applying DPO to the final selected set: preference information is first used to decide what SFT supervision should enter training.

ProDS 把目标偏好转化为数据选择信号。小规模 SFT 预热先得到具备指令跟随能力的模型；在构造出的目标对上进行 DPO 预热，得到朝向偏好回答、远离非偏好回答的梯度方向。一条训练记录的价值由其影响与这两个方向的相关性共同决定。

被选中的对象仍是普通的指令—回答三元组，只是在筛选期间附加成对偏好梯度和分数。构造预热对时，GPT-4 用于判断生成的目标回答是否不同于参考回答。这不同于直接对最终子集使用 DPO：偏好信息首先用于决定哪些监督微调数据应进入训练。

title: Method
方法
html:
First, ProDS randomly takes 5% of the training pool for SFT warm-up. The warmed-up model generates target responses; when GPT-4 judges a generation different from the reference, the generation becomes a rejected response and the reference becomes a chosen response for a 5% DPO warm-up. The resulting DPO gradients define positive and negative preference directions on the target validation set.

For every candidate training triplet, ProDS computes an influence representation and cosine similarities to both direction sets. Simulated annealing sets an instance-level trade-off between positive alignment and negative alignment, producing a final rank; the top subset is used for SFT. The paper uses Alpaca's 52,002 triplets and also roughly 270K examples from FLAN V2, CoT, Dolly, and OpenAssistant, so a reuse must keep target-validation construction separate from final testing.

首先，ProDS 从训练池中随机取 5% 进行 SFT 预热。预热后的模型生成目标回答；当 GPT-4 判断生成结果不同于参考答案时，生成结果成为拒绝回答，参考答案成为选择回答，用于 5% 数据的 DPO 预热。所得 DPO 梯度在目标验证集上定义正向和负向偏好方向。

对每个候选训练三元组，ProDS 计算影响表示及其与两组方向的余弦相似度。模拟退火为每个样本设定正向对齐与负向对齐之间的权衡，产出最终排序；排名靠前的子集用于 SFT。论文使用 Alpaca 的 52,002 条三元组，也使用来自 FLAN V2、CoT、Dolly 和 OpenAssistant 的约 270K 条样本，因此复用时必须把目标验证集构造与最终测试明确分开。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
On the target-agnostic Alpaca setting, ProDS compares with IFD and other selection rules across Vicuna, Koala, WizardLM, Self-Instruct, and LIMA-style evaluations. The paper reports that its selected top 5% is closer to the WizardLM test distribution after t-SNE than IFD's top 5% (average Euclidean distance 67.13 versus 85.85), and analyses show its gains are not explained only by shorter preferred responses.

For targeted selection, the paper compares with BM25, DSIR, RDS, and LESS on MMLU, TyDiQA, and BBH while asserting no training examples are directly related to those target tasks. This supports the claim that preference-derived selection can add information beyond answer-generation similarity, but GPT-4 pair judgment and validation construction remain possible sources of target leakage and evaluator bias.

在目标无关的 Alpaca 设置中，ProDS 在 Vicuna、Koala、WizardLM、Self-Instruct 和 LIMA 风格评测上与 IFD 等选择规则比较。论文报告其选出的前 5% 数据在 t-SNE 后更接近 WizardLM 测试分布：平均欧氏距离为 67.13，而 IFD 前 5% 为 85.85；分析还显示，其收益并不只由更短的偏好回答解释。

对于目标化选择，论文在 MMLU、TyDiQA 和 BBH 上与 BM25、DSIR、RDS 和 LESS 比较，并说明训练数据中没有与这些目标任务直接相关的样本。这支持偏好导出的选择能提供超出回答生成相似度的信息，但 GPT-4 的成对判断和验证集构造仍可能引入目标泄漏与评判器偏差。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
Targeted selectors such as LESS associate a training record with target response-generation gradients. ProDS changes the selected record's criterion from helping produce a reference answer to aligning with a bidirectional preference representation: a useful record should support movement to a preferred response and not support movement away from it.

DPO, influence-style selection, and simulated annealing are established ingredients. The new decision is to synthesize positive and negative target-preference consistency before choosing SFT examples. Inspect how the target pairs were judged, which validation samples supplied gradients, and whether the selected subset still helps when the evaluator, target distribution, or response-length preference changes.

LESS 等目标化选择器把训练记录与目标回答生成梯度关联。ProDS 改变了选择记录的标准：不再只要求它有助于生成参考答案，而是要求它与双向偏好表示一致——有用记录应支持向偏好回答移动，也不应支持远离偏好回答的移动。

DPO、影响式选择和模拟退火都是已有成分。新的决策是在选择 SFT 样本之前，综合正向与负向目标偏好的一致性。应检查目标对如何被判断、哪些验证样本提供梯度，以及更换评判器、目标分布或回答长度偏好后，所选子集是否仍然有效。

title: Limitations
局限
html: ProDS adds offline SFT and DPO warm-up, GPT-4 comparison, influence computation, and annealing before the final SFT, so its data-efficiency claim does not mean the selection process is cheap. Its preference representation relies only on DPO gradients, as the authors note, and target preferences may depend on a judge or reference style rather than stable user values. Because validation samples are derived from test-set structures, a reuse must separate selection validation from the final benchmark and audit every model/API and dataset license.
ProDS 在最终 SFT 前增加了离线 SFT 与 DPO 预热、GPT-4 比较、影响计算和退火，因此其数据效率主张不意味着筛选过程廉价。正如作者所述，它的偏好表示只依赖 DPO 梯度；目标偏好也可能依赖评判器或参考答案风格，而非稳定的用户价值。由于验证样本来自测试集结构，复用时必须把选择验证与最终基准分开，并审计所有模型/API 与数据集许可证。

title: Usefulness
用途
html: Use ProDS when an SFT dataset must be tailored to a known downstream preference surface rather than merely compressed. Reserve a clean target-validation set, build and audit preference pairs, score candidate records by both directions, then compare selected SFT with random, quality-only, and target-gradient selectors under the same token budget. It is not suitable when using benchmark-derived validation data would contaminate final evaluation or when an external judge cannot be legally and reproducibly used.
当监督微调数据需要贴合已知的下游偏好表面，而不只是被压缩时，可以使用 ProDS。应保留干净的目标验证集，构造并审计偏好对，按双向偏好给候选记录打分，然后在相同 token 预算下将选出的 SFT 与随机、只看质量和目标梯度选择器比较。当基准导出的验证数据会污染最终评测，或无法合法且可复现地使用外部评判器时，它不适用。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html: The important distinction is preference-guided SFT selection, not another DPO objective. ProDS represents both moving toward and moving away from a target preference. Its warm-up uses 5% for SFT and 5% for DPO in the reported recipe. Target validation is part of the selection mechanism and therefore an audit surface. The paper reports no dedicated code or data release, so reproduce only after rebuilding its pair construction and split protocol.
关键区别是由偏好引导的 SFT 选择，而不是另一种 DPO 目标。ProDS 同时表示向目标偏好靠近和远离目标偏好。其报告配方中，SFT 预热使用 5%，DPO 预热也使用 5%。目标验证是选择机制的一部分，因此本身就是审计表面。论文没有报告专门的代码或数据发布，只有重建其成对构造和划分协议后才应复现。
